definitions.explanation: An estimate that is not exact; used when giving approximate numbers or amounts.
In general terms; for the most part.

examples.japanese: {大凡|おおよそ}⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{着|つ}きます→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: It takes approximately 30 minutes to arrive.

notes:
USAGE: {大凡|おおよそ} is often written in hiragana (おおよそ) in modern usage.

POSITION: Usually appears before numbers or nouns.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大凡|おおよそ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見当|けんとう}→見当：02795_kentou⟧ (rough idea)
- {大凡|おおよそ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{数|かず}→数：00204_kazu⟧ (approximate number)
- {大凡|おおよそ}⟦{想像|そうぞう}→想像：02489_souzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧ (can roughly imagine)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧〜 - about, approximately (more common for numbers)
- ⟦だいたい→だいたい：00831_daitai⟧ - roughly, generally (more casual)
- ⟦およそ→およそ：02534_oyoso⟧ - approximately (similar but can also mean 'at all' in negative contexts)
- ⟦ざっと→ざっと：02833_zatto⟧ - roughly, at a glance
